recipe.boot_env: the 12 FLOW_BOOT_ENV keys: the six artifact paths above, identity cache/identity.json, RECORD_DIR <case>/records, RECORD_CACHE_SECONDS '30', FRAME_WIDTH/HEIGHT '640', BATCH_SIZE per case
recipe.case_layout:
each case gets <work>/item10/<part>/<nn>/ with models/pose.onnx, models/libparser.so (b'parser-lib
'), models/libtracker.so (b'tracker-lib
'), config/tracker.yml (b'tracker-config: synthetic
'), config/infer.yml and cache/
recipe.components: placeholder cases call model_composition._verified_identity_field with ComponentBinding('pose', 'extractor', <field>=<compiled>) and a SimpleNamespace component
recipe.digests: every sha256 is written as <sha256:ROLE>: onnx[<variant>], engine(b<batch>), parser-lib, tracker-lib, tracker-config, infer-config[<part>/<nn>], served-infer-config[<part>/<nn>]:batch-size=<n>
recipe.engine: cache/model.engine holds b'engine b<batch>\n' (written by the recorder for G1 and boot cases, by the fake nvinfer for G2)
recipe.identity: worker.tools.edge_engine_build.identity_for(...) with image_digest 'sha256:golden-image', written as json.dumps(sort_keys=True) + newline; G1 edits are named in each case
recipe.infer_config: config/infer.yml lines: '[property]', 'onnx-file=<case>/models/pose.onnx', 'model-engine-file=<case>/cache/model.engine', 'batch-size=<batch>', 'infer-dims=3;640;640' (overrides are visible in each G2 case's infer_config_lines)
recipe.nvinfer:
build_engine(run=fake): the fake reads config-file-path, writes the engine at model-engine-file (or, in adopt mode, beside onnx-file as <name>_b<batch>_gpu0_fp16.engine) and returns rc 0 with stdout '[FullDims Engine Info]
0 INPUT kFLOAT images 3x640x640 min: 1x3x640x640 opt: <batch>x3x640x640 Max: <batch>x3x640x640
1 OUTPUT kFLOAT output0 300x57 min: 0 opt: 0 Max: 0
' (tests/test_edge_engine_build.py _engine_info)
recipe.onnx: onnx.helper graph 'pose', one Identity node frames -> output0 (FLOAT, input and output share the declared dims), opset 13, ir_version 9, built in memory per tests/test_edge_engine_build.py _write_onnx; only declared and onnxruntime-read input dims are recorded

worker/tools/edge_engine_build.py:build_engine (L205; shape check L230 before the cache lookup L231), _verify_onnx_shape (L63), _render_infer_config (L29), _verify_served_infer_config (L53), _verify_engine_profile (L115), identity_for (L141), _nvinfer_build_command (L168) @030aaf1
review.note: build_engine checks the ONNX shape before the cache lookup, so a fixed batch refuses without touching model.engine or identity.json, but a served infer config is rendered before that check and survives the refusal; a refusal after nvinfer ran (missing onnx-file line, profile mismatch) leaves nvinfer-build/ and possibly model.engine behind. verify_engine_identity checks batch_size, then each digest key in order (engine first), then image_digest (only non-empty, never compared). onnxruntime 1.29 load errors derive from Exception only, so they escape input_dims unwrapped; an empty dims tuple raises IndexError at boot. Messages name the remedy (edge-engine-build, worker.tools.export_pose_onnx) that Rust must reword.
